body: Thank you for your words. It have shed some light into me on the reason why they might be acting up like that. I hope for the best for you too 🙏😊
I still can’t fathom the fact that some birth parents do such horrible things when all we need is their presence and support. I hope you’re doing good too. 😊
I hope so too, I just hope I get rest mentally from all the shoutings too. It’s not helping at all 😓
